story.heading: The farm is just down the road.
story.body:
Hacienda Arborea is a working farm a few kilometers from where you're staying. The same land that shapes the landscape around your casa also grows much of what ends up on your plate.

Food security is at the heart of how we operate. The vegetables, herbs, and produce your chef works with were harvested that morning — not sourced from a distribution center days away. You eat what grew closest to you, tended with care, picked at its peak.

This is what real farm-to-table looks and tastes like.

concept.heading: Your kitchen, ready before you arrive
concept.body:
We arrive before you do and stock your fridge and pantry with what grows closest to you — vegetables, dairy, meats, fish, and seasonal fruit, so you can put together your own breakfast, lunch, and dinner throughout your stay.

Every ingredient comes from our curated network of Costa Rican producers: high-altitude coffee from Tarrazú, fresh catch from the Pacific, vegetables from the volcanic foothills, raw dairy from our own farm, honey from the northern zone. Organic, traceable, and delivered the morning of your arrival — no grocery runs, no guessing, no compromises.

farm.heading: About Hacienda Arborea
farm.body:
Hacienda Arborea was born from a simple idea: instead of relying on a single farm, build a network of producers across different regions of Costa Rica, each an expert in what their land does best.

High-altitude coffee from Tarrazú, fresh catch from the Pacific, vegetables from the volcanic foothills, honey from the northern zone. Every ingredient carries a region's first and last name. Every bite tells a story of patience, care, and deep respect for the Costa Rican land.

casaPalmera.description: The casa's design mirrors the elegance of its namesake tree, with spacious interiors, refined decor, and modern amenities. A perfect choice for families or friends seeking a peaceful escape in nature.
casaPalmera.about:
Casa Palmera's design mirrors the elegance of its namesake tree, with spacious interiors, refined decor, and modern amenities.

A perfect choice for families or friends seeking a peaceful escape in nature, the casa offers a harmonious blend of comfort and the wild beauty of Costa Rica's landscape.

goodToKnow.title: Our collective of curated jungle residences are located in a pristine mountain environment, and part of the magic of staying here comes with a few things worth keeping in mind to ensure a comfortable experience.

meshDoors.title: Mesh Doors and Windows
meshDoors.description: Our collective of curated jungle residences are equipped with mesh screens on doors and windows to keep insects out. We kindly ask that you keep them closed at all times, especially in the evenings, to ensure a comfortable and bug-free stay.

powerOutages.title: Power Outages
powerOutages.description: Due to our remote mountain location, occasional brief power outages may occur. We recommend keeping your phone charged and having a flashlight handy, both of which are available at the casa.

transportation.title: Transportation
transportation.description: A 4x4 vehicle with 4-wheel traction is required to access the casas and surrounding areas safely. Arborea can arrange transportation for you — but if you prefer to rent your own vehicle, make sure it has full 4-wheel drive engaged, not just all-wheel drive.

foodStorage.title: Food Storage
foodStorage.description: We ask that all food be stored in the refrigerator or in sealed containers when not in use. Leaving food out in the kitchen or common areas can attract wildlife, which is a natural part of our mountain ecosystem but best admired from a distance.

nighttimeLighting.title: Nighttime Lighting
nighttimeLighting.description: We provide exterior lighting along pathways for your safety. Please keep in mind that lights left on unnecessarily at night tend to attract insects, so we suggest turning off any lights in rooms or terraces that are not in use, and keeping doors and windows closed.

wellnessSpa.title: Spa & Wellness Experience
wellnessSpa.subtitle: GV Massage Home Service · Luxury wellness brought to your casa

story.heading: Relax, restore and reconnect
story.body:
Experience a luxury in-casa wellness journey designed to relax, restore, and rejuvenate. GV Massage Home Service brings certified therapists directly to your casa, offering a curated menu of treatments in the comfort and privacy of your jungle retreat.

From couples experiences to signature spa rituals, every treatment is thoughtfully crafted to bring balance and indulgence directly to you — surrounded by the sounds and beauty of Costa Rica's natural environment.

massages.heading: Massages
massages.description: All massage styles are available in 60 or 90 minute sessions. Choose the technique that best suits your body and mood.

items.name: Relaxing Massage
items.description: A gentle, flowing technique that relieves accumulated stress, improves circulation, and restores the body's natural balance. The perfect choice for a first experience or a full day of rest.

items.name: Deep Tissue Massage
items.description: Deep-pressure technique targeting the most tense muscle layers. Ideal for releasing chronic contractures, back pain, and tension built up from sports or desk work.

items.name: Hot Stone Massage
items.description: Smooth heated stones are combined with flowing strokes to melt away muscle tension and promote deep relaxation. A warming, meditative experience for body and mind.

items.name: Aromatherapy Massage
items.description: A powerful combination of relaxing massage with 100% natural essential oils selected for your specific needs. Awakens the senses, balances the nervous system, and deepens the state of relaxation.

items.name: Lomi Lomi Massage
items.description: A traditional Hawaiian massage using long, rhythmic strokes with the forearms to release tension in a continuous, flowing motion. Deeply restorative for both body and spirit.

fourHands.label: Four Hands Massage
fourHands.description: Two therapists working in perfect synchrony, doubling the sensation of relaxation. An immersive, deeply restorative experience unlike any other.

items.name: Natural Facial
items.description: Treatment formulated with white tea as the base ingredient. Nourishes and protects the skin with natural antioxidants while revitalizing from within. Ideal for all skin types, especially sensitive or dehydrated skin.

items.name: Deep Facial Cleansing
items.description: A complete 60-minute treatment including cleansing, exfoliation, steam, extraction, toner, ultrasonic peeling, and a specialized mask tailored to your skin type. The reset your face needs.

addons.heading: Enhancements
addons.tagline: Add 20 minutes of extra treatment to any service and fully personalize your experience for just $40.

packages.heading: Spa Rituals & Packages
packages.description: Immersive multi-treatment experiences designed for deeper restoration. Each package combines complementary therapies for a complete wellness journey.

items.name: Couple Massage
items.description: Two therapists, two tables, one shared moment of total peace. Ideal for couples, friends, or family members who want to unwind together in perfect harmony.
includes: Choice of Relaxing, Deep Tissue, or Aromatherapy

items.name: Honeymoon Package
items.description: The ultimate experience for a perfect honeymoon in Costa Rica's South Pacific.
includes: Honey, Milk & White Chocolate Body Scrub

items.name: Romantic Escape
includes: Couple Massage (Relaxing, Deep Tissue, or Aromatherapy)

fishingTours.title: Fishing Tours & Marine Experiences
fishingTours.subtitle: Offshore, inshore, river and combo tours aboard Arborea's own boat

story.heading: Out on the water with Arborea
story.body:
From mar afuera runs chasing Tuna and Marlin to quiet river mornings after Snook and Mangrove Snapper, every trip is operated directly by Arborea Experiences — our boat, our captain, our routes.

Choose the tour that fits your day, from a full offshore adventure to a relaxed combo of whale watching, fishing, and beach time. Prices below are estimates; your captain will confirm the final rate based on conditions and group size.

packages.heading: Fishing Packages & Experiences
packages.description: Select the tour you'd like to book. Each package includes captain and crew — see full conditions below.
packages.durationNote: Half-day tours run approximately $650 to $700, compared to $1,200 for a full-day offshore trip. Shorter tours don't include a full lunch — only drinks and fruit are provided. Duration shown is our best estimate per tour and may be adjusted by the crew.

items.name: Offshore Fishing
items.description: Runs in open water. The most common rate currently charged is $1,200.

items.name: Isla del Caño Fishing
items.description: Fished 3 km from the island's shore (outside national park limits). Typical rate is $950.

items.name: Whales, Fishing & Beach Combo
items.description: Includes whale watching, a short fishing session, and lunch with free time at San Josecito beach.

items.name: Inshore Fishing
items.species: Roosterfish, Mackerel, Barracuda, Snapper, Jack, Corvina, Snook
items.description: Fished close to shore, just past the river mouth.

items.name: River Fishing
items.description: All-inclusive. Fished along the nearby river and its channels.

items.name: Mangrove, Wildlife & Beach
items.description: Early morning departure for birdwatching, returning in the afternoon after time at the beach.

conditions.heading: Good to Know
items: Half-day tours: approx. $650–$700, versus $1,200 for a full-day offshore trip.
Half-day meals: drinks and fruit only — no full lunch on shorter tours.
Fruit on board: only pineapple and watermelon are offered. Banana and papaya are avoided — they spoil quickly and leave an odor on board.
Snorkel gear: not offered on the Isla del Caño tour — it requires special park permits, national park fees, and certified equipment the boat doesn't currently carry.

fishingTours.ctaHeading: Ready to head out on the water?
fishingTours.ctaSubheading: Reach out on WhatsApp and we'll help you pick the right tour.
fishingTours.note: Prices are estimates per boat/group and may vary with conditions, group size, and season. Your captain will confirm final pricing before departure.
